Method of Attack: Injecting malicious JavaScript code into Volusion e-commerce platform checkout pages to steal payment card data
Dynamic injection of card data stealing script
Reading credit card information fields, encoding in Base64, storing in sessionStorage, and exfiltrating data to attacker-controlled domain
Attack Vector: Compromise of Volusion infrastructure to inject malicious JavaScript
Loading malicious script from Google Cloud Storage bucket 'volusionapi'
Malicious script loaded via 'vnav.js' JavaScript used for UI navigation
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious script loaded from non-affiliated source other than sesamestreetlivestore.com or volusion.com
